name: Clearpath Jackal with Manipulation Package
summary: A small 17 kg four-wheel outdoor research UGV (IP62) with a Kinova Gen3 lite arm and an Intel D435 camera, sold by Clearpath as a preconfigured package for mobile manipulation of small payloads.

germany.statusNote: Génération Robots lists the Jackal from 14,560 € net (17,472 € incl. VAT, delivery within 4 weeks for the standard package) and shows the Manipulation Package among the Jackal packages, priced on request; Clearpath names Generation Robots (Berlin) and MYBOTSHOP as German distributors.

sellers.name: Generation Robots
sellers.note: Base Jackal "From €17,472.00 VAT incl. €14,560.00 VAT excl.", "Deliveries within 4 weeks" (Standard package); the Manipulation Package with "Kinova Gen3-Lite Manipulator" is listed under Packages without a price. Berlin office per Clearpath's distributor list.

sellers.name: MYBOTSHOP.DE
sellers.note: Listed by Clearpath as a German distributor; no Jackal manipulation listing read.
